summary: Independently verified the nginx routing fix for GET /api/menu/version on production VPS https://loyalty.pizzadenfert.fr. All 7 read-only HTTPS verification tests passed (7/7, 100%). /api/menu/version now returns HTTP 200 with the expected JSON schema {rev: int, count: int, updated_at: str|null}; consistency confirmed across 5 consecutive calls plus a 5-second-delayed retry (no flakiness, no cache effects). Auth-protected routes (/api/loyalty/me, /api/reservations/me) still return 401 properly, and /api/menu still returns a non-empty array. Response served as application/json via nginx 1.28.3 fronting FastAPI/uvicorn on the active backend (port 8001). Fix is LIVE and confirmed.

rca_of_issue: RCA (already diagnosed by main agent, now verified): nginx vhost pizzadenfert-loyalty was upstream-proxying /api/ to 127.0.0.1:8000 — a stale Jun-29 orphan uvicorn whose code predated the /api/menu/version route, returning 404 for that path while other routes happened to coexist. Fix applied: vhost upstream changed to 127.0.0.1:8001 (active pizzadenfert.service with current code), stale orphan killed, broken pizzadenfert-api.service masked, nginx reloaded. Verification (this run): 7 HTTPS test cases all pass — /api/menu/version returns 200 with body {"rev":0,"count":21,"updated_at":null}, consistent over 5 calls and over a 5s-delayed re-run, Content-Type application/json, Server nginx/1.28.3, while /api/menu remains 200 (21 items) and unauthenticated /api/loyalty/me and /api/reservations/me correctly return 401 {"detail":"Missing token"}. Mitigation already in place; no further action required.
